thread:
maya: quick flagging — saw a P95 increase (~20ms) on short seqs (32/64) after selector change deployed on canary this morning. traces: https://redwood.prod/traces/abcd
liam: ugh. thanks for flagging. is this on fusion->flash path or paged flip?
maya: looks like attention path picked fused-flash in nodepool A; previously we were hitting fused-paged. microbench attached.
maya: ```
# microbench single-step
seq=32 model=gpt-small
selector=old: p95=8.3ms
selector=new: p95=28.1ms
``` 
devon: that's big. can you paste nvprof/NVTX spans? also check kv cache hit rate — cold prefix might amplify
maya: nvtx snapshot shows big kernel time at 'flash_attn_forward' with high SM occupancy but heavy synchronization
maya: kv cache stats: hit_rate=0.98 after warmup but first-token latencies spike
perf-bot: flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/fg/12987 (shows hot in attention transpose)
liam: hypothesis: new selector favors fused-flash for short seqs w/ small batch; fused implementation has memcpy overhead that dominates at tiny batches
sasha: try forcing KERNEL_CHOOSER=prefer_paged and re-run microbench on same canary
maya: ran that, results: selector=force_paged p95=9.0ms
maya: steps to reproduce I ran:
```
export RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=auto
./bench --model gpt-small --seq 32 --batch 2 --iters 200
```
liam: ok we need bisect on the selector commit range. @ci-bot can you spin up param sweep: selector=baseline|new|force_paged across pools A/B, varying batch 1-4 and seq 16/32/64
ci-bot: created job #4782 — param sweep queued. ETA ~12m :hourglass:
devon: also add variation with KV_WARMUP=disabled to see coldprefix effect
sasha: if bisect points to selector change, we may add a simple cost model: if seq<=48 && batch<=2 prefer paged
maya: agree. I'll open PR with a temporary config toggle for canary until we have perf fix
liam: also add microtrace snapshots to the perf dashboard for the run so we can compare kernels before/after
maya: plan: run bisect -> if culprit, revert selector in canary + roll forward a tuned cost heuristic. I'll post updates here
devon: assign to @liam and @maya for followup. :thumbsup:
